My girlfriend (not a voat user) and I have gotten pretty big into trying different kinds of junk foods every so often just to taste the cool varieties of candies, chips, crackers, cookies, that this world has to offer. So I created this subverse so that other junk food connoisseurs can share links, reviews, and discussion about all manner of awesome things to try!

Here's a working list of the categories that I know about. We can use this to tag submissions for easy searching:

  • Cakes
  • Candy
  • Cereal
  • Chips
  • Chocolate
  • Cookies
  • Crackers
  • Fast Food
  • Ice Cream
  • Popcorn
  • Soft Drink
  • Fried

If you have any suggestions about more categories to add to this list, I'll keep it in the Sidebar for reference.

The /v/JunkFood Disclaimer

/v/JunkFood does not recommend or condone consuming mass quantities of any of the junk foods listed in it. We recommend that eating foods that do not offer any nutritional value should ALWAYS be done in moderation and in combination with an otherwise healthy and well-balanced diet. We like to try different junk foods as a hobby, and recommend that you keep that in mind. We love oreos, but we know that eating the whole pack in one sitting isn't good. We only want to highlight the variety of weird, exciting, and fun flavors that exist the world over. We do NOT advocate that any individual should make junk food a large part of their daily diet.

Advertising

/v/JunkFood doesn't exist as an advertising opportunity for junk food retailers. Any "blatant" attempts at marketing products on /v/JunkFood will be removed. Let's make sure that the only junk in this subverse is the food. :)
